content.text:
The robot is resting in front of the green panel at the end of the corridor, and I've called `rest` as you asked.

The route wasn't a single straight run. The corridor went straight for about 4.5 m, then turned left. From there it continued roughly 3 m more, with a final bend to the right, before the panel was directly ahead. I stopped about 0.3 m short of the panel's base. The last reading showed side walls at 0.56 m, and the panel filled the forward view. I didn't measure the exact gap to the panel, so "in front" is by camera estimate, not a measured distance.

The robot was stood up at the start, and it walked only forward and turned by commanded angles. It did not bump or fall, and the battery is at 99%.
